question: Can the predeclared training EDF be acquired via PhysioNet's official S3 distribution and its EDF+ TAL task annotations extracted after exact publisher-checksum and pinned-digest checks?
limits: Single training subject/run; not a subject-generalization result
Annotation parser has not been independently compared against publisher .event or another reader
No EEG signal samples decoded, model trained, test subject accessed, or performance measured
Checksums establish source-index consistency, not independent publisher attestation
No raw EDF stored in GitHub or CI artifacts
decision: Remain Research / Simulation. Next independently compare all T0/T1/T2 onset and duration events against the publisher's companion .event annotation or an independent EDF+ reader before decoder work.
advancement_gate: Source-pinned independent event agreement, then frozen subject-disjoint preprocessing and matched-coverage decoder/abstention/gate evaluation.
reframe_gate: Stop and repair annotation contract on any irreconcilable event count, onset, duration or task mapping mismatch.
